claim.claim-text: 1. A method for transmitting a physical layer protocol data unit, PPDU, within an operating bandwidth in a wireless local area network, the method comprising:

generating a PPDU including a first part and a second part, wherein the first part has a first subcarrier spacing, the second part has a second subcarrier spacing, the first part comprises a first short training field, STF, being a legacy-STF, L-STF, a first long training field, LTF, being a legacy-LTF, L-LTF, a first signal, SIG, field being a legacy-SIG, L-SIG, field, and a second SIG field, the second part comprises a second STF, a second LTF and a data field; and transmitting the PPDU over the operating bandwidth, wherein the second LTF includes a plurality of 26-tone LTF sequences including a plurality of 26-tone base sequences multiplied by +1 or -1, wherein the operating bandwidth is divided into a plurality of sub-channels for transmission of the data field, and wherein each of the plurality of sub-channels of the data field is associated with a respective one of the plurality of 26-tone LTF sequences.
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the plurality of 26-tone base sequences includes a first 26-tone base sequence and a second 26-tone base sequence.

3. The method of claim 2, wherein the plurality of 26-tone LTF sequences include the first 26-tone base sequence multiplied by +1, the first 26-tone base sequence multiplied by -1, the second 26-tone base sequence multiplied by +1, and the second 26-tone base sequence multiplied by -1.
4. The method of claim 3, wherein the operating bandwidth is 20MHz.

5. The method of claim 4, wherein the first 26-tone base sequence multiplied by +1 and the second 26-tone base sequence multiplied by +1 are transmitted at subcarriers having positive subcarrier indices, and the first 26-tone base sequence multiplied by -1 and the second 26-tone base sequence multiplied by -1 are transmitted at subcarriers having negative subcarrier indices.
6. The method of claim 1, wherein the first subcarrier spacing is four times greater than the second subcarrier spacing.
7. The method of claim 1, wherein the operating bandwidth is divided into a plurality of sub-channels for transmission of the first part, each sub-channel of the first part having 20 MHz bandwidth.
8. A device for transmitting a physical layer protocol data unit, PPDU, within an operating bandwidth in a wireless local area network, the device comprising:
at least one memory; and at least one processor coupled to the at least one memory, the at least one processor configured to cause:

generating a PPDU including a first part and a second part, wherein the first part has a first subcarrier spacing, the second part has a second subcarrier spacing, the first part comprises a first short training field, STF, being a legacy-STF, L-STF, a first long training field, LTF, being a legacy-LTF, L-LTF, a first signal, SIG, field being a legacy-SIG, L-SIG, field, and a second SIG field, the second part comprises a second STF, a second LTF and a data field; and transmitting the PPDU over the operating bandwidth, wherein the second LTF includes a plurality of 26-tone LTF sequences including a plurality of 26-tone base sequences multiplied by +1 or -1, wherein the operating bandwidth is divided into a plurality of sub-channels for transmission of the data field, and wherein each of the plurality of sub-channels of the data field is associated with a respective one of the plurality of 26-tone LTF sequences.
9. The device of claim 8, wherein the plurality of 26-tone base sequences includes a first 26-tone base sequence and a second 26-tone base sequence.

10. The device of claim 9, wherein the plurality of 26-tone LTF sequences include the first 26-tone base sequence multiplied by +1, the first 26-tone base sequence multiplied by -1, the second 26-tone base sequence multiplied by +1, and the second 26-tone base sequence multiplied by -1.
11. The device of claim 10, wherein the operating bandwidth is 20MHz.

wherein the first 26-tone base sequence multiplied by +1 and the second 26-tone base sequence multiplied by +1 are transmitted at subcarriers having positive subcarrier indices, and the first 26-tone base sequence multiplied by -1 and the second 26-tone base sequence multiplied by -1 are transmitted at subcarriers having negative subcarrier indices.
13. The device of claim 8, wherein the first subcarrier spacing is four times greater than the second subcarrier spacing.
